title: Neurons and Networks
summary:
This episode of The Moonshot Podcast explores what the mind can teach us about technology and how technology can help our minds.

First, Astro is joined by Sarah Laszlo from Project Valkyrie to discuss how looking at biological brains, such as that of a fruit fly, might unlock the key to more energy-efficient supercomputing.
